<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/stations/{stationId}/check-outs"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Clears a station's occupant — the Station aggregate's `CheckOut` invariant enforced through the application layer. Takes no request body. Like check-in, this publishes no domain event (see [ADR-0014](https://iqvo.github.io/fulfillment-execution/docs/adr/0014-labor-performance-integration-hooks)).
